full.method: Default automatic channel selection, final snapshot after four seconds of silence and md_flush; uppercase and collapse whitespace; spaces, punctuation and O/0 count as edits
full.snr_reference: Nominal key-down sine power / Gaussian noise power in 2500 Hz before PCM clipping, as specified by Vail cwgen
full.paired_noise: CRC32 seed depends on WPM, message and repeat; the same noise realization is used across SNR and generator modes
full.threshold_method: Sustained threshold: lowest tested SNR whose mean CER and every higher tested SNR are <= the stated limit; no interpolation
